endpoint: Process start to observed response to a harmless ordinary main-menu action

design.extensions: None. Preserve every refusal/error/adverse observation; any changed-input run requires a separately identified plan.

tolerances.aa_rule: Absolute A/A difference must not exceed max(0.5 seconds, 5 percent of their mean).
tolerances.control_rule: Mean late-cycle control startup must not exceed mean early-cycle control startup by more than 0.5 seconds. Report every sample and spread.
tolerances.improvement_rule: Use paired block differences against the same control, report direct and incremental differences, sample spread and uncertainty. A nonpositive or unresolved baseline increment supports no percentage claim.
